messages.subject: Project Marlin - COMPLETION
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Series B financing of Brightwater Analytics Limited completed today. Subscription monies of £18,000,000 have been received and the Series B shares allotted. The executed Subscription Agreement is attached; the completion bible will follow next week. We'll file SH01 and the special resolution at Companies House within the 15-day window.

Congratulations to everyone.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
